notes: Effects gallery improvements: (1) Each preset card now previews the effect on YOUR scene's actual caption text (brackets stripped, truncated) instead of a generic placeholder — so you see it on your words before applying. (2) Highlight reveal no longer looks like it does nothing: when the caption has no [bracketed] phrase, applying it now wraps the whole caption in [ ] so it actually reveals, and a toast explains how to narrow the highlight to one phrase (e.g. [phrase|#3742f0]). Works for the main caption, text layers, and apply-to-all-scenes. index.html only.
